retraction.reason: Retracted in M40b: the climate agreement of December 2015. The atlas holds no climate or energy record at all — the Kyoto Protocol was among the candidates the import refused for want of a lane, and the Portuguese fires of 2017 are wired to the reform they produced and not to any climate policy. There is nothing here the agreement can be argued to have changed and nothing here that produced it.

title: Paris Agreement
summary: Wikidata item Q21707860, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "international agreement from 12 December 2015 within the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) dealing with greenhouse gas emissions mitigation, adaptation and finance starting in the year 2020". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
